source.title: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future

items.name: Cold Adaptation
items.text: The arabuk reduces the effects it suffers from cold environments by one step.

items.name: Snow Vision
items.text: Snow doesn't impair an arabuk's vision; it ignores Concealment from snowfall.

items.name: Deafening Echo
items.text: On a critical hit with an antler reverberation Strike, the target is Deafened for 1 minute.

rules.text: On a critical hit with an antler reverberation Strike, the target is Deafened for 1 minute.

items.name: Dominance Display
items.text:
Frequency once per hour

---

Effect The arabuk postures and roars. All non-arabuk creatures within 30 feet must attempt a DC 20 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to this arabuk's Dominance Display for 24 hours.

Success The creature takes 2d8 sonic damage.

Failure The creature takes 2d8+9 sonic damage and is Frightened 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes 2d8+9 sonic damage and is Frightened 2.

items.name: Pounce
items.text: The arabuk Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the arabuk began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after this ability's Strike.

items.name: Reverb
items.text:
Trigger The arabuk hits a creature with an antler Strike

---

Effect The arabuk snarls, causing its antlers to reverberate and dealing an additional 1d6 sonic damage to the creature struck. This is in addition to the normal sonic damage from the antler Strike.

items.name: Snow Stride
items.text: The arabuk ignores difficult terrain, greater difficult terrain, and uneven ground from non-magical ice and snow.
